comparison.success: Compare full field set, null presence, arrays/order, decimal strings, raw Unicode and status. Normalize only generated IDs/times under a recorded bijection; preserve version/current/rowVersion and relative chronology.
comparison.error: Compare actual Native status, envelope/code/message, Zod issue order and nested paths; do not blanket-normalize DB/ORM errors or infer 409.
comparison.database: Observe before/after main and all child rows, current/version/supersedes/status/rowVersion, numeric text and timestamps, auth_session row changes, audit/security deltas and connection/transaction terminal state.
comparison.evidence: Preserve exact requests, raw responses, SQL before/after, fault/competition barrier sequence, candidate/source hashes, UI screenshots/network capture, per-case result and native-witness receipt. This file contains no Pass claims.

fixtureDefinitions.project: Actual R3B project producer; distinct active/blocked/closed project and presigning/non-presigning stages, owned/unowned/owner-only/org-only/missing-owner cases. Record IDs and baseline rows.
fixtureDefinitions.externalReferences: Root may use previously delivered baseline/summary mechanisms or isolated fixtures for the existing FK rows. Distinguish that setup from delivery of R4/R5 write chains. Include valid same-project and other-project rows plus nonexistent UUIDs.
fixtureDefinitions.permissions: Real cookie sessions: none, invalid/expired/revoked/disabled, project:read only, project:write only, both, neither, and read without sensitive finance grants. CSRF correct/missing/mismatch cases. Capture original auth pending-flush states.
